purpose: Replace the same-process canonicalization tautology with two fresh operating-system processes that each scan both allowed panels and independently reconstruct the complete R2-A1 v1.1.0 panel fingerprint.
accessOrder: freeze and commit this correction before starting either corrected empirical build
builder A starts with a fresh scan state, loads the external HMAC key, opens both allowed panels read-only, and calls scan_panel once per panel
builder B starts in a separate operating-system process with a fresh scan state and independently repeats both panel scans
compare only deterministic build fields: logical payload, complete manifest bytes, ordered shard descriptors, shard-set hash, counts, input evidence hashes, and HMAC-key fingerprint
require distinct process identifiers, exactly two scan_panel calls per process, and byte-exact equality of the complete deterministic fingerprint
publish a machine proof bound to the manifest and a report correction; never label a same-process reserialization as independent evidence
deliberately alter one reported rebuild fingerprint after two real scans and require the comparator to exit non-zero

testStatistic.primary: number of unequal deterministic fingerprint fields across builder A and builder B
testStatistic.processIndependence: number of distinct operating-system process identifiers
testStatistic.scanExecution: number of scan_panel calls in each process and in total
testStatistic.effectiveN: two complete builds of the same two-panel input; files, rows, shards, and hash fields are deterministic reconstruction material rather than independent empirical observations

nullModel: At least one deterministic fingerprint field differs, both builds share one process identifier, either process does not execute exactly two scan_panel calls, or the deliberate mismatched fingerprint remains green.
threshold: Zero fingerprint mismatches, two distinct process identifiers, two scan_panel calls per process, four total scan_panel calls, and non-zero exit for the deliberate mismatch sabotage.
requiredInvariants: the two build processes share no in-memory scan state
each process opens and scans panel-entdeckung.sqlite and panel-validierung.sqlite itself
the external HMAC key is never printed or written to the repository
the panel artifact remains byte-identical because this correction changes verification rather than linkage or seam construction
the independent-rebuild proof writes no raw CIK, company name, accession number, ticker, reversible identity, or HMAC key
no end-test file or row is opened, counted, or rendered
Blocker 3, accepted-time seam placement, multiple-seam counts, and Task 2 remain untouched
explicitNonClaims: Two byte-identical builds establish reproducibility for the pinned inputs, implementation, runtime, and external HMAC key; they do not prove reproducibility under other runtimes or changed inputs.
This correction does not validate the seam guard or seam placement.
This correction does not make Task 1 complete and does not begin Task 2.
This correction does not alter the sealed confirmatory verdict.
